name: GFA
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.98). Replaced keyword guess "logic-error".
rootCause: The GFA token was exploited on the BNB chain, which resulted in a loss of assets worth approximately $15,000. The root cause of the exploit is a lack of access control. The vulnerable contracts had functions for calculating rewards, for which anyone could invoke a call to them. The hacker was able to manually calculate and generate the rewards and drain the tokens. The exploiter has already laundered the stolen assets into Tornado Cash.
